rationale: AMT has gapped up 6.11% on no specific news catalyst visible in the last 24 hours, which creates uncertainty about the fundamental driver and sustainability of the move. Price is sitting at 82% of today's range near the session high with momentum appearing to stall (last few 1m candles showing tight consolidation around $179.80–$180.40), but with only 68 minutes to close and a 6% gap already captured, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear — chasing long near the high risks a gap fade, while shorting a strong momentum move with no clear reversal signal is equally dangerous. Given today's realized loss and limited remaining loss budget, the prudent action is to stand aside.
